diagnosis: Adenocarcinoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: A clinical ophthalmoscopy image shows a darkly pigmented tumour with abrupt margins. The tumour has perforated the retina and is surrounded by exudates.

diagnosis: Adenoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: Cystic adenoma. This heavily pigmented tumour is located on the inner surface of the choroid as a cytologically bland neoplasm containing cyst-like spaces.

diagnosis: Adenocarcinoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: A heavily pigmented tumour rests on the inner surface of the choroid and invades the overlying retina.

diagnosis: Adenocarcinoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: A largely non-pigmented retinal pigment epithelium adenocarcinoma with abrupt margins is seen. The tumour rests on the inner surface of the choroid and invades the overlying retina. This tumour was observed clinically to arise from a congenital hypertrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium.

diagnosis: Adenocarcinoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: Linear bands of tumour cells rest on PAS-positive septa. The tumour cells have prominent nucleoli (PAS stain).

diagnosis: Adenocarcinoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: The nuclei of pleomorphic retinal pigment epithelium tumours have prominent nucleoli and peripheral chromatin margination.

diagnosis: Adenoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: The cells form characteristic linear bands and have bland nuclei.

diagnosis: Adenoma of the retinal pigment epithelium
legend: A mass lies below the retina in this clinical image.
